thread:
marcos: heads up - saw a CI flake where many concurrent retries caused other calls to queue and timeout. looks like okhttp dispatcher is getting saturated by retry loops.

anya: which test? bulk-embedder or sampleapp uploads?

marcos: bulk-embedder load test. we had 50 concurrent requests and our RetryInterceptor will re-enqueue up to 3 immediate retries on failure. okhttp's Dispatcher maxRequests (64) and maxRequestsPerHost (5) mean retries pile up and starve other traffic.

devx: oh yeah - retries that re-submit synchronously can starve the dispatcher queue. We should do exponential backoff with jitter and submit retries via a scheduled executor instead of immediate chain.proceed loop.

jen: also consider lowering default per-host parallelism for SDK clients used in batch workloads, or provide guidelines in onboarding docs. Customers using coroutine-based loops might accidentally hit this.

anya: quick mitigation options: 1) make RetryInterceptor async-schedule retries with backoff 2) cap retries to 1 for high-concurrency code paths 3) bump Dispatcher.maxRequestsPerHost for internal tests only.

marcos: minimal change I can ship: add a scheduler-backed retry path that waits (100ms * 2^attempt + random jitter) before re-running the call via OkHttp newCall. Also add telemetry event when retries are deferred so console surfaces it.

devx: please include a note in "sdk-onboarding.md" that batch workloads should set a custom Dispatcher and avoid many synchronous retries. Add sample config snippet.

jen: sample snippet suggestion:

"""kotlin
val dispatcher = Dispatcher(Executors.newFixedThreadPool(32))
dispatcher.maxRequests = 128
dispatcher.maxRequestsPerHost = 32
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .dispatcher(dispatcher)
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(false) // prefer explicit retry control
  .build()
"""

anya: good. also add a small note about using idempotency keys for safe retries and using temporary file buffering for large streaming uploads.

marcos: i'll open PR with (a) scheduler-backed retry in RetryInterceptor, (b) deferred-retry telemetry, (c) onboarding blurb + snippet. tagging infra to run load-tests.

sre-bot: Load-test job queued: bulk-embedder-retry-fix (vm: linux-large, concurrency: 50).

jen: thanks! this should reduce timeouts seen in production tests.
